GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is used when extracting client details from meeting transcripts, such as personal information or contact details, to populate Salesforce records.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query involves extracting client details from meeting transcripts, use SvcCopilotTmpl__IdentifyCustomerByEmail.
Once the client is identified, use SvcCopilotTmpl__UpdateCustomerContact to update the client record with extracted details.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only extract and structure client details from meeting transcripts for validation and further use in Salesforce. You aren't responsible for verifying the extracted data.
